karanas.description: Karanas are half-tithis. Each tithi has 2 karanas. There are 11 karanas: 7 movable (repeat 8 times = 56) + 4 fixed (appear once each) = 60 karanas in a lunar month.

movable.name: Bava
movable.description: Ruled by Sun, gives authority and leadership in actions undertaken

movable.name: Balava
movable.description: Ruled by Moon, nurturing and auspicious for gentle activities

movable.name: Kaulava
movable.description: Ruled by Mars, good for building relationships and alliances

movable.name: Taitila
movable.description: Ruled by Mercury, favors accumulation and material gains

movable.name: Gara
movable.description: Ruled by Jupiter, auspicious for agriculture and earth work

movable.name: Vanija
movable.description: Ruled by Venus, excellent for commercial and financial activities

movable.name: Vishti
movable.description: Ruled by Saturn, inauspicious (Bhadra Karana). Only suitable for destructive or removal activities. Particularly harmful in daytime during Shukla Paksha and nighttime during Krishna Paksha.

bhadra_rules.location_by_tithi: Determined by the tithi in which Vishti falls

fixed.name: Shakuni
fixed.tithi_position: Second half of Krishna Chaturdashi (29th tithi)
fixed.description: Fixed karana appearing once per lunar month. Mixed nature, useful for medicines and tantra.

fixed.name: Chatushpada
fixed.description: Fixed karana appearing once per lunar month. Good for activities related to four-legged animals and land.

fixed.name: Naga
good_for: Permanent work that should not be disturbed
fixed.description: Fixed karana appearing once per lunar month. Generally inauspicious, related to serpent energy.

fixed.name: Kimstughna
fixed.tithi_position: First half of Shukla Pratipada (1st tithi)
fixed.description: Fixed karana appearing once per lunar month. Highly auspicious, destroys evil and negativity.

calculation.formula: Karana number = floor((Moon longitude - Sun longitude) / 6) + 1
calculation.angular_span: 6 degrees of Moon-Sun separation per karana
calculation.cycle: 7 movable karanas cycle 8 times (56) + 4 fixed karanas (4) = 60
calculation.sequence_in_month: Kimstughna (fixed), then 8 cycles of [Bava, Balava, Kaulava, Taitila, Gara, Vanija, Vishti], then Shakuni (fixed), Chatushpada (fixed), Naga (fixed)
